title: Java Software Engineer - Connectors - Remote
description:
Jitterbit automates and orchestrates business systems to empower teams, unlock value, and accelerate business transformation. With Jitterbit, organizations can streamline operations, enhance data accessibility, and deliver on a growing list of IT needs more quickly and confidently.

For organizations ready to modernize and innovate, Jitterbit provides a unified AI-infused low-code platform for integration, orchestration, automation, and app development that accelerates business transformation, boosts productivity, and unlocks value. The Jitterbit Harmony platform, including iPaaS, API Manager, App Builder and EDI, future-proofs operations, simplifies complexity and drives innovation for organizations globally.

**Job Description**

Jitterbit is seeking a Java Backend Software Engineer to join our Engineer team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) and API Management platform that has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and API Manager platform to solve mission-critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers’ systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?

About the Team

The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations.

Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists.

Key team values:

* Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
* Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
* Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
* Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay ahead

About the Job

As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

* Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365.
* Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc.) for multi-tenant SaaS environments.
* Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven).
* Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles.
* Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems.
* Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability.
* Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization.
* Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization.

About You

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built.

You will be successful in this role if you:

* Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer.
* Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture.
* Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives.
* Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers.
* Are able to make data-driven decisions.
* Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from.
* Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push.

**Qualifications**

We are looking for:

* 7+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements.
* 5+ years working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants.
* Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems.
* Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter-service communication patterns.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns.
* Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e).

Technical Skills and Experience:

* Expert-level Java (Java 8+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc.).
* Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling).
* Message brokers & event streaming: Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, or similar; understanding of at-least-once delivery, dead-letter queues, and stream processing.
* Database technologies: Strong SQL (query optimization, indexing); experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra) and their consistency trade-offs.
* Containerization & orchestration: Proficiency with Docker; practical experience with Kubernetes or container runtimes in production.
* Version control: Advanced Git workflows (branching strategies, rebasing, cherry-picking); experience with GitHub or similar platforms.
* CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar; ability to write build pipelines, deployment scripts, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* OS & systems: Comfortable with Linux command line; understanding of OS-level concepts (memory allocation, processes, file systems, networking).
* Observability: Experience with logging (ELK, Splunk), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin).

**Additional Information**

**What You’ll Get:**

* Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
* Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes.
* Career development and mentorship
* A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heart

**Please be advised that Jitterbit does not:**

* Conduct interviews through unsecure messaging platforms.
* Request sensitive personal information, such as social security numbers or bank details, during initial contact.
* Require payment or fees from applicants at any stage of the hiring process.
* Offer unrealistic salaries or benefits packages.

title: Sr. Full Stack Engineer with AI
description:
**Position: Sr. Full Stack Engineer with AI**

**Location: Viman Nagar, Pune, MH - Hybrid**

**Start Date:**
**ASAP (30-60 day notice period is max...ideally sooner)**

**Shift Time: 4:30 pm to 1:30 am IST**

**Note:**
**Must have at least 8 years of total experience - Need an engineer who can handle both frontend and backend development**

**Job Description:**

We are looking for a Full-Stack Developer to build production-ready, goal-driven AI agents that reduce the administrative and digital workload placed on technicians, along with the technician-facing interface people use to work with them.

This is not a traditional data science or LLM experimentation role. The ideal candidate is a hands-on AI engineer who has built agents that reason toward a goal, interact with applications and APIs, take actions, and run reliably in production.

Strong full-stack skills matter equally. You will build both the AI and agent capabilities and the front-end experience that lets technicians review, approve, and act on what the agents do.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**AI agents**

* Design, build, and enhance goal-driven AI agents that take real-world digital actions.
* Turn an initial proof of concept into a production-ready agentic solution.
* Build workflows where agents complete multi-step tasks independently, with human approval when required.
* Work with Anthropic's enterprise Claude platform to develop and enhance AI capabilities.

**Front end**

* Build intuitive, technician-facing interfaces, not just back-end AI functionality.
* Turn design specifications and Figma prototypes into responsive, accessible UI components.
* Show agent activity, status, and approval requests clearly, so technicians stay in control.

**Back end and integration**

* Develop integrations between AI agents and enterprise systems through APIs.
* Use Python and Java for AI, automation, integration, and application development.
* Partner with colleagues focused on AI engineering, Snowflake and data engineering, and ServiceNow.

**Architecture and quality**

* Help decide the right architecture and technical approach as the project evolves, rather than implementing predefined features.
* Build for production readiness, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.

**Required Qualifications**

**AI engineering**

* Strong hands-on AI engineering experience, with agents that have moved beyond experimentation or basic LLM usage into production.
* Strong understanding of agentic AI concepts and terminology.
* Experience building solutions where agents reason, work toward goals, invoke tools or APIs, and take actions.
* Understanding of LLMs and modern generative AI architectures, plus solid data science fundamentals.

**Front end (required)**

* Hands-on experience building user-facing applications with React and TypeScript, including Next.js or a similar framework.
* Strong HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+), including responsive layouts with Flexbox and Grid.
* Experience with a utility or component styling approach such as Tailwind CSS.
* Ability to turn Figma designs into pixel-accurate, accessible, cross-browser interfaces.
* Experience consuming REST APIs and managing client-side state, loading states, and error handling.

**Back end and integration**

* Strong full-stack software development experience across back-end and user-facing development.
* Strong Python and Java knowledge, and an understanding of how Python applies to AI-driven solutions.
* Experience designing, developing, and consuming APIs.

**Working style**

* Comfortable in an evolving environment where requirements and technical approaches change as the team learns.
* Strong communication skills, able to discuss technical decisions, trade-offs, and the future of AI with both technical and business stakeholders.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Anthropic's Claude platform, Model Context Protocol (MCP), RAG, or workflow tools such as n8n.
* Familiarity with Snowflake or other data platforms, and with ServiceNow integrations.
* Experience with Node.js, GraphQL, or Django alongside Python and Java.
* Cloud and delivery experience: AWS, Docker, CI/CD, and automated testing such as Cypress or Jest.
* Experience designing human-in-the-loop approval flows for AI-driven actions.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**About The Role**
As a Data Scientist II, you will contribute to the design, development, testing, and delivery of data science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions that address business needs and improve customer experiences. You will apply statistical analysis, predictive modeling, Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and modern AI frameworks to build reliable analytical and intelligent capabilities.
  
  
This individual contributor role participates across the data science lifecycle, from data collection and preprocessing through model development, evaluation, integration, and production support. Working with a moderate level of guidance, you will solve complex technical problems, collaborate with senior data scientists and cross-functional partners, and expand your knowledge of enterprise AI technologies, business processes, and customer needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop data science and AI solutions: Prepare and analyze structured and unstructured data, engineer features, and contribute to predictive models, NLP and LLM solutions, RAG pipelines, intelligent assistants, and Agentic AI workflows.
* Evaluate and improve solution quality: Apply suitable metrics, test datasets, error analysis, experiment tracking, model validation, performance testing, and responsible AI checks to improve accuracy, relevance, reliability, latency, and cost.
* Support deployment and engineering: Build reusable code, APIs, notebooks, pipelines, containers, model artifacts, monitoring components, and automated workflows with engineering and senior data science team members.
* Collaborate, communicate, and maintain standards: Translate requirements into assigned deliverables, communicate insights through visualizations, prototypes, reports, and documentation, and manage code, data, and experiments in line with security, privacy, governance, version control, responsible AI, and current ML and AI practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* 3+ years of relevant professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, analytics, or AI-focused software development.
* Hands-on experience preparing data, conducting exploratory analysis, building features, developing models, and evaluating results for practical business problems.
* Experience contributing to at least one Machine Learning, NLP, Generative AI, LLM, RAG, or Agentic AI solution through development, testing, integration, or production support.
* Working knowledge of model validation, experiment design, performance metrics, data quality, and reproducible development practices.
* Ability to complete a range of technical assignments and solve moderately complex problems within established policies, procedures, and architectural patterns.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex information clearly in straightforward situations.
* Strong collaboration, learning agility, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.

**Technical Skills**

* Programming and analytics: Proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience in Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Jupyter, data preparation, feature engineering, analysis, and visualization using Matplotlib, Seaborn, Tableau, or Power BI.
* Machine Learning, statistics, and NLP: Practical knowledge of supervised and unsupervised learning, model selection and evaluation, statistical analysis, experimentation, and foundational deep learning and NLP concepts using frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, or SpaCy.
* Generative AI and Agentic AI: Experience with prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, RAG, LLM evaluation, document-based use cases, tool-enabled agents, and workflow orchestration using frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph, with exposure to Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, MLflow, and model APIs.
* Engineering, cloud, and governance: Experience with reusable Python code, REST APIs, Git, unit testing, CI/CD, containers, databases, data pipelines, and cloud services, with awareness of monitoring, observability, security, privacy, cost, explainability, and responsible AI practices.

**Success Measures**
Success in this role is measured through:
  
  

* Accurate, timely, and well-documented data preparation, analysis, and reporting.
* Reliable contributions to Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI development, testing, integration, and production support.
* Measurable improvement in model or application quality, including accuracy, relevance, reliability, latency, cost, or user experience.
* Clear visualizations and actionable insights that support product and business decisions.
* Reusable, maintainable code and effective automation of repeatable data and AI workflows.
* Consistent adherence to data quality, security, governance, responsible AI, documentation, and team development standards.
* Effective collaboration with senior data scientists, engineering teams, product partners, and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated growth in technical capability, business understanding, and ownership of moderately complex assignments.

title: Sr. Martech Enterprise System Engineer
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
Avalara's Marketing Technology team is scaling its execution capabilities and expanding its AI capabilities to keep pace with a growing go-to-market engine. The systems that power campaign execution, lead lifecycle management, and marketing operations, Workfront, Marketo, and our leads pipeline, require strong, hands-on technical talent to build, maintain, and continuously improve them.
  
  
This IC4 MarTech Engineer role is for a strong technical leader who can transition marketing capabilities from a digital marketing paradigm to an agentic marketing approach by integrating, automating, and configuring new agentic models and solutions across our enterprise capabilities, building reliable integrations, automating marketing workflows, and ensuring lead data flows accurately from capture to CRM handoff.
  
  
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**

* Build and maintain integrations between Marketo, Salesforce CRM, Workfront, and adjacent MarTech systems, delivering reliable, well-documented solutions.
* Engineer and optimize the lead lifecycle from capture and enrichment through scoring, routing, and CRM handoff, reducing lead leakage and improving data accuracy across the pipeline.
* Develop and maintain automation for campaign operations, asset management workflows in Workfront, and lead management processes in Marketo, replacing manual effort with reliable, auditable automation.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions by working closely with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, and Sales Operations to understand needs and deliver working solutions on time.

* Contribute to technical documentation by keeping integration maps, data flow diagrams, and runbooks current so the team can operate and onboard efficiently.
* Support peers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and hands-on collaboration, raising the technical quality of the team's output.
* Monitor platform health and proactively flag performance issues, data anomalies, or integration failures before they impact marketing operations

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Qualifications**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in marketing technology, enterprise systems engineering, or a closely related technical discipline have recent hands-on work building AI/ML systems
* Solid hands-on experience with Marketo, including program setup, smart list logic, API integrations, lead lifecycle configuration, and data management.
* Hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront, including workflow configuration, template management, and automation for marketing or creative operations.
* Experience building and maintaining lead management pipelines, including capture, enrichment, deduplication, and scoring.
* Demonstrated production experience with LLMs, RAG pipelines, vector search/embeddings, or recommendation systems — not prototypes, but systems that served real traffic
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, and JavaScript/Node.js, with experience owning AWS Lambda data pipelines from design to deployment.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and modern ML tooling (e.g., MLflow, SageMaker, or equivalents)

**Bar Raiser Expectations**

* Hold themselves and others to high standards of technical quality, data integrity, and operational accountability
* Demonstrate strong judgment when making platform and technical tradeoffs, especially those that affect campaign performance, lead data quality, or system reliability.
* Raise the performance of those around them through mentorship, rigorous code reviews, and clear documentation.
* Simplify complexity, translating ambiguous marketing requirements into clean, maintainable technical solutions.
* Challenge assumptions respectfully and bring data into technical decisions.
* Leave every system, process, and team they touch stronger than they found it.

**AI Expectations**
Avalara is an AI-first company. This role is expected to be an
**AI Bar Raiser**
, not a casual user of AI tools, but someone who embeds AI into how MarTech work gets done and elevates the AI capability of the team.
  
  
**Specifically, This Role Is Expected To**

* Use AI to accelerate development and troubleshooting, including AI-assisted code generation, API debugging, and automated testing for MarTech integrations.
* Apply AI to lead intelligence, leveraging AI/ML-based lead scoring and intent signal processing to improve pipeline quality and Sales efficiency.
* Automate content and campaign operations using AI tools to reduce manual effort in asset creation, QA, and campaign setup within Marketo and Workfront.
* Identify and quantify AI-driven improvements, e.g., reduction in lead processing time, improvement in MQL-to-SQL conversion, or hours saved through intelligent workflow automation.
* Share AI best practices with the MarTech team and Marketing Operations, helping peers adopt AI tools responsibly and effectively.
* Apply AI responsibly, with awareness of data privacy, governance, and ethical use standards relevant to marketing data and customer information.

Candidates who cannot demonstrate specific, measurable AI impact in prior roles do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

description:
**About Onit**
We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.
  
  
We’re a team of innovators using
**AI at the core**

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
****Position Summary****
The Data Scientist owns the statistical methodology behind a new customer-facing benchmarking capability in Onit's AI-driven legal operations platform. Drawing on data from multiple source systems across enterprise legal management, matter management, and spend management, this role determines which organizations are genuinely comparable, decides where the line sits between a defensible comparison and one that is not, and ensures the product communicates confidence honestly to end users. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and the Data Architect on a Databricks-based platform, the Data Scientist sets the evidential standards, data quality targets, and governance for pooled, anonymised cross-customer analytics.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Benchmarking Methodology: Own the statistical methodology behind customer-facing benchmarking, end to end.
* Comparability Modelling: Build and validate a model that determines which organizations are genuinely comparable, using features such as service mix, pricing, scale, and geography.
* Defensibility Thresholds: Decide where the line sits between a comparison Onit can defend and one it cannot, and design the product's behaviour on both sides of it.
* Data Quality Programme: Profile data quality across multiple source systems and lead a measurable improvement programme against a defined target, partnering with Data Engineering on remediation.
* Entity Resolution: Define the approach for resolving duplicate and conflicting records across systems that were never designed to reconcile with one another.
* External Data Assessment: Assess whether missing attributes can be responsibly supplemented from external sources, and set the evidential bar for doing so.
* Governance & Privacy: Work with Product on methodology and governance for pooled, anonymised cross-customer analytics, including aggregation thresholds.
* Communicating Uncertainty: Explain uncertainty clearly to non-statisticians and help the product communicate confidence honestly to end users.

**Required Skills**

* 7+ years in applied data science, analytics engineering, or a closely related quantitative role, including ownership of methodology for externally facing analytics.
* Strong applied statistics: sampling, variance, confidence intervals, and sound judgement about small samples (e.g., able to explain why a three-item average may or may not be publishable).
* Practical, production experience with entity resolution, record linkage, deduplication, or master data management.
* Strong SQL, and Python or Ruby for analysis and modelling; hands-on experience working in Databricks (notebooks, Spark/PySpark, Delta tables) or a comparable cloud data platform.
* Experience diagnosing and remediating data quality problems at scale, including reasoning about why data is missing before deciding what to do about it.
* Rigorous validation habits: defines baselines and success metrics before building, and reports honestly against them.
* Ability to communicate uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders without overstating confidence or being unhelpfully vague.
* Working proficiency with AI tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate analysis, code, and documentation, with the statistical judgment to critically validate AI-generated output.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building benchmarks, rate comparisons, scoring models, or indices intended for external consumption.
* Experience with anonymisation, aggregation thresholds, or privacy-preserving analytics.
* Experience working with a cloud data warehouse or lakehouse (Databricks preferred).
* Experience in a regulated or commercially sensitive domain, ideally legal.
* Experience defining data quality SLAs or acceptance thresholds with business stakeholders.

Reporting to the Head of Risk Appetite and Capital Analysis, the candidate will own front-to-back onboarding and maintenance of historical risk-factor data across spot, curves, spreads, and volatility surfaces. The role requires strong understanding of market risk time-series construction, returns and shock generation, proxy and backfill methodologies, data-quality controls, and the downstream impact of data changes on risk measures. The successful candidate will work closely with Market Risk, Risk Analytics, Quantitative Analytics, and Technology teams.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead front-to-back onboarding of historical market data and risk-factor time series, including spot, curve, spread, and volatility surface data.
* Manage time-series implementations end to end, covering requirements analysis, data sourcing, mapping, transformation, validation, testing, and production delivery.
* Assess the suitability and completeness of market data used in VaR, SVaR, stress testing, FRTB, and related capital calculations.
* Perform data-quality analysis across completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, outliers, stale observations, and risk-factor coverage.
* Develop, document, and enhance proxy and backfilling methodologies for illiquid, sparse, or unavailable historical time series.
* Conduct quantitative impact assessments for data-source changes, history extensions, methodology updates, and proxy enhancements.
* Investigate material data exceptions and production issues, identify root causes, and drive remediation with Risk Analytics and Technology teams.
* Partner with Quantitative Analytics and Market Risk stakeholders on risk-factor modelling, methodology changes, and model-data requirements.
* Define test scenarios, execute UAT and regression testing, validate results, and coordinate issue resolution for HMD platform changes.
* Contribute to automation, monitoring, and tooling enhancements that improve the scalability, transparency, and control of time-series management.
* Prepare management information on data quality, proxy usage, backfilling activity, risk-factor coverage, exceptions, and remediation progress.
* Maintain clear documentation of data lineage, source selection, transformations, proxy logic, controls, approvals, and implementation outcomes.
* Support governance, audit, model-risk, and regulatory reviews relating to historical market data and market risk measurement.

* Master's degree from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 university in Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, Economics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.

* Effective stakeholder-management skills and the ability to work across Risk, Quantitative Analytics, Technology, and control functions.

title: Lead Golang Developer, Litmus GCC
description:
****Who is Litmus****
Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
  
  
AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
  
  
We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
  
  
Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.
  
  
****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
  
  
****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.
  
  
****Have real impact, fast****
You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
  
  
****Join a high-performance team****
We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
  
  
****Our culture****
At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
  
  
We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Lead Golang Developer, you will own the design, delivery, and production health of the Go services behind Litmus’s cloud and SaaS platform. You will lead a team of Go engineers building Kubernetes-based, high-performance distributed systems that ingest, process, and serve real-time industrial data at scale.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will write and review code every week, set the technical direction for your services, and be accountable for how they run in production for customers. The role is based in our Pune office and is fully in-office.
  
  
****What You’ll Do****

* Lead a team of Go engineers: plan work, break down features, mentor, and run code and design reviews
* Architect and build cloud-native, multi-tenant SaaS services in Go that are scalable, secure, and observable
* Design high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems for real-time data ingestion, streaming, and processing
* Deploy and operate services on Kubernetes, including Helm charts, operators, autoscaling, rollout strategies, and resource tuning
* Own production reliability: define SLOs, lead incident response and root-cause analysis, and drive fixes to completion
* Profile and optimize Go services for CPU, memory, concurrency, and network performance
* Build and maintain gRPC and REST APIs, plus integrations with message brokers such as Kafka, NATS, or MQTT
* Establish engineering standards for testing, CI/CD, code quality, security, and documentation
* Partner with Product, QA, DevOps/SRE, and Edge teams to turn requirements into reliable releases
* Evaluate new technologies and drive improvements in architecture, tooling, and developer productivity

****What You’ll Bring****
****Must Have****

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including 6+ years building production systems in Go
* 3+ years leading engineers as a tech lead or lead developer, including mentoring and code review
* Proven experience building and running SaaS applications in production, including multi-tenancy, zero-downtime deployments, on-call ownership, and incident management
* Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating high-performance distributed applications on Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS, or self-managed), including Helm, autoscaling, and resource tuning
* Deep knowledge of Go concurrency (goroutines, channels, context), memory management, and profiling with pprof and tracing tools
* Strong grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consistency, partitioning, replication, fault tolerance, backpressure, and rate limiting
* Experience with gRPC/Protobuf, REST APIs, and messaging systems such as Kafka, NATS, or RabbitMQ
* Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases (such as PostgreSQL, Redis, and time-series stores) and caching strategies
* Experience with observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and structured logging
* Solid CI/CD and Git practices, and a strong testing culture (unit, integration, and load testing)
* Clear communication and the ability to work across Product, QA, and DevOps teams

****Nice to Have****

* Experience writing Kubernetes operators or controllers (controller-runtime, Kubebuilder)
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform, and GitOps tooling such as Argo CD or Flux
* Exposure to service meshes (Istio, Linkerd) and API gateways
* Familiarity with industrial or IIoT data, edge-to-cloud architectures, or protocols such as MQTT and OPC UA
* Experience with time-series data, stream processing, or data platform products
* Knowledge of SaaS security and compliance practices (SSO/OIDC, RBAC, SOC 2)
* Contributions to open-source Go or cloud-native projects
